meta.name: RiffTrax
meta.description:
RiffTrax, the guys who make movies funny, are the former stars of the cult TV show Mystery Science Theater 3000.  They’ve brought their comedic riffing treatment to over 200 feature films - from the cheesiest B movies to the latest Hollywood blockbusters

Shows: RiffTrax: A Dangerous Man, RiffTrax: Dancin' It's On, RiffTrax: Fangs Of The Living Dead, RiffTrax: The Phantom Creeps, RiffTrax: Sons of Hercules
Available on: Pluto TV, Samsung TV Plus
